class.name: MinaMCPServer
class.brief_description: Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server singleton for Mina Engine.
class.description: Exposes Mina Engine's internal editor, project, scene, node, asset, script, animation, lighting, playback, debugging, and export APIs over a localhost-only MCP HTTP server so external AI agents (such as Claude Code and Codex) can operate the engine directly. Future modules and GDScript plugins can extend the server dynamically via [method register_script_tool] and [method register_script_resource].

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the local MCP HTTP server. Refuses non-loopback hosts unless [param allow_remote] is explicitly enabled.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the MCP server and closes all active client connections.

method.name: restart
method.description: Restarts the MCP server using the current host and port configuration.

method.name: register_script_tool
method.description: Registers a custom MCP tool implemented in GDScript or GDExtension.

method.name: unregister_tool
method.description: Removes a registered MCP tool by name.

signal.name: status_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the MCP server starts, stops, or encounters an error.

signal.name: sessions_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an external MCP client session connects, initializes, or disconnects.

signal.name: tool_executed
signal.description: Emitted whenever an MCP tool finishes executing.
